note: Oneida County, ID publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Zoning Map link on maps.php) and the Development Code as PDF; no ArcGIS REST, WFS or bulk zoning-district polygon layer was found on the county site, the state parcel viewer, the Idaho Tax Commission ArcGIS folder, or ArcGIS Online. Malad City, the largest city, publishes its official zone map as a PDF too (Ordinance 474 / City Zoning Map PDF). The only ArcGIS zoning-like hits were Oneida County, Wisconsin, which is the wrong county. The IDWR statewide parcel layer has no zoning attribute.
